fomod.Name: Survival Accord
fomod.Author: CageTV
fomod.Description: Connects Firmament's Exploration perks to Last Seed 2026 (Hunger, Fatigue, camping) and Frostfall 2026 (cold Exposure). A small SKSE plugin and updated scripts built for the 2026 versions, without Firmament.dll being touched. Hunterborn support is coming soon. Install after Last Seed 2026 and Frostfall 2026.
